svg.title: Wisconsin and Korea, at the same scale
svg.desc: Wisconsin and both Koreas side by side, using local Lambert azimuthal equal-area projections with identical map units. Great Lakes water is masked out of Wisconsin’s administrative boundary. Neenah, Seoul and Pyongyang are approximate city-center locators. Relative area is preserved; the two shapes are not geographically adjacent.
svg.text: Natural Earth 1:50m · land silhouettes · local equal-area projections at identical scale
